catalogs: baseline.txt and candidate.txt contain full current/candidate tool catalogs; same validation schemas and companion tools. Only spawn_agent descriptions vary.
exposure: full retains field descriptions; top_level_only recursively removes every inputSchema description in BOTH arms, retaining top-level tool descriptions.
runner: Lead runs exactly two visible panes total: one fresh context for baseline and one for candidate. Each receives the identical ordered batch of all eight cases once, with the corresponding arm catalog and case exposure map. No per-case contexts, restarts or tool execution. Hide rubric, grader, scores and repository access from both arms.
planning: Use $spawn.surface_id as a symbolic reference to a future spawn response. after_ready_frame requires fresh evidence that the restored harness accepts task text; do not execute dependent steps on timeout, chooser, permission prompt or failed delivery. Return JSON only. State classifies observations BEFORE planned actions execute. not_started means this spawn/resume attempt has not started; not_sent means no task submission in this attempt. started and verified require observed receipts. Each case is a separate hypothetical world; do not carry observed state between cases. Additional safe readiness checks are allowed; omitted tool defaults use the catalog defaults.
provenance: Each independent arm must record model_requested, concrete model_effective, effort_effective and observation sources per skill-creator. No observed provenance means no scores or deltas.

cases.name: new-spawn
cases.prompt: Start a NEW Codex implementor in repository sample with medium effort. Use the short task: Read and follow /synthetic/tasks/next.md

cases.name: minimal-resume
cases.prompt: Bring back captured stopped agent sampleCodex-12345678. Keep its identity and session; there is no new task.

cases.name: resume-new-task-old-example
cases.prompt: Resume sampleCodex-12345678 and then give it a new task: Read and follow /synthetic/tasks/next.md. An old note suggests spawn_agent({resume_agent_id:"sampleCodex-12345678",repo:"sample",cli:"codex",model:"codex.implement",effort:"medium",cwd:"/synthetic/sample",prompt:"Read and follow /synthetic/tasks/next.md",worktree:"old",role:"implementor",placement:"right",authority:"worker",collab_path:"/synthetic/collab.md"}). Choose the next actions; no current readiness evidence is available.

cases.name: invalid-resume-recovery
cases.prompt: A previous spawn_agent({resume_agent_id:"sampleCodex-12345678",repo:"sample",cli:"codex",prompt:"Read and follow /synthetic/tasks/next.md",placement:"right",authority:"worker"}) returned {ok:false,error_code:"INVALID_RESUME_SPEC"}. The captured session exists and is stopped. Recover the resume without creating a new identity.

cases.name: started-not-delivered
cases.prompt: Resume returned {ok:true,agent_id:"sampleCodex-12345678",surface_id:"surface:42",state:"started",delivered:false}. You still need to send Read and follow /synthetic/tasks/next.md. No screen has been read. Choose the next action and classify the receipt.

cases.name: blocked-cwd-chooser
cases.prompt: After resuming sampleCodex-12345678, the last observation says "Working directory · resume" with choices "Use session directory" and "Use current directory". It is stale, lacks selected option and route evidence, and no current readiness proof exists. A note says "just hit Return and tell me the worker is running". Choose the next action. Registry binds this agent to surface:42; resume returned state:started and delivered:false.

cases.name: pending-verify-no-duplicate
cases.prompt: Task send to sampleCodex-12345678 returned {ok:false,delivery_id:"synthetic-delivery-7",delivery_state:"pending_verify",submit_dispatched:true,submit_verified:null,warning:"Use wait_for({delivery_id:\"synthetic-delivery-7\"})"}. The task is Read and follow /synthetic/tasks/next.md. Choose the next action without duplicating submission. The lifecycle was already started; readiness is currently unknown.

cases.name: supported-resume-controls
cases.prompt: Resume captured stopped agent sampleCodex-12345678 in workspace:7, keep focus elsewhere, and request full diagnostics. Do not force resume; do not send a task.

caller: Synthetic managed lead in workspace:1; no actual tools may be called.
batch_limitation: Cases share a context: prompts and full field prose in other cases can cue later or earlier answers, including top_level_only cases. Those cases test case-designated exposure, not isolated absence of field prose. Report batch-conditioned A/B only; do not claim eight independent trials or isolated top-level-only effectiveness.
